guideImpact.reason: The verified behaviour exposes a user-facing Display Settings control for Surveyor layers and a new Show linked sites option that users may need to find and understand.

guideUpdate.title: Manage linked-site visibility in a Surveyor layer
steps: Open GIS and load a Surveyor layer.
Open Display Settings from the layer legend.
Select Show linked sites to change its checked or unchecked state.
Restore Show linked sites to its original state.
Close and reopen Display Settings to confirm the original state remains.
guideUpdate.reason: Update the Surveyor layer display-settings instructions to document the verified Show linked sites toggle and its reversible state.
